changes.old: Tears the target apart from within, dealing $s1 Shadow damage every $t sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by $s2%. Lasts $d.
changes.new: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting $s1 Shadow damage every $t sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by $s2% for $d.

changes.old: You gain Soul Harvest for $1242853d if a victim is killed while afflicted with your Drain Soul. Soul Harvest allows your Mana to regenerate at $m1% of normal speed while you are casting spells, and grants a $m2% increase to your Mana regeneration.
changes.new: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by $m1% for $1242853d and allows $m2% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
